title: Revalidate authority at side-effect dispatch after pause or revocation
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He loads an inline graph that plans then publishes. He walks with `graph_walk` until *before* the publish execute node, advances the live authorization epoch (revocation), then continues. Publish fails closed with `revalidation_failed` and the effect runner never runs. Related: `fangore_insp_wake_reresolve`, `fangore_human_review_pending`, `fangore_insp_auth_epoch_resume`. Tracks MH-DOTS-02[^insp-dots-02] via stepped control SG-08[^sg-reval].
implementation: `revalidate_before_effect` on `execute`-phase nodes; `GraphExecutor.live_authorization_epoch`; `graph_walk` start/until/set_live_epoch/continue. Observe/prepare phases skip revalidation.
